mainEntity.name: How do you check a 300Tdi engine fits my Discovery 1?

acceptedAnswer.text: We check the engine number, VIN and registration, then compare the mounts, ancillaries, EGR equipment and turbo fitment with the replacement. 300Tdi engines from other Land Rover models can differ, so compatibility is confirmed first.

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between used, reconditioned and rebuilt 300Tdi engines?

acceptedAnswer.text: A used engine comes from a donor vehicle, a reconditioned engine is stripped and given new wear parts, and a rebuild restores your existing engine. We recommend an option after assessing the fault.

mainEntity.name: Can I buy a 300Tdi engine without having it fitted?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Trade buyers, independent garages, restorers and private customers can buy supply only. Alternatively, choose supply and fit and our technicians will install the engine at our Grays, Essex workshop.

mainEntity.name: What affects the cost of a Discovery 1 300Tdi engine replacement?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost depends on the engine option, the condition of your current engine, any ancillary parts such as a turbo or injection pump, and whether fitting is included. Send your registration or VIN for a written quote.

mainEntity.name: Is there a warranty on a replacement 300Tdi engine?

acceptedAnswer.text: Warranty cover depends on the engine option and whether we carry out the installation. We confirm the exact terms in writing with your quote, so you know what is covered before work starts.

mainEntity.name: Do you deliver 300Tdi engines across the UK?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. We deliver engines throughout the United Kingdom from our Grays workshop. Delivery arrangements and costs are confirmed in your quote, and supply and fit customers can bring their Discovery to us.

mainEntity.name: How long does a 300Tdi engine replacement usually take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timescale depends on engine availability, whether a rebuild is needed and any additional work found during inspection. We provide an estimated timeframe with your quote and keep you informed throughout.
